purpose: Reuse the already-audited public Moreyra locus universe from EAzami for aza3 R1B-0 reference-transfer testing without treating any reconstructed set as the unpublished final 350-locus matrix.

historical_target_counts.interpretation: The 1061 public named-locus universe is reproducible, but the papers consistently report 1064 mapped target loci. The exact author target/reference file underlying the 1064 count is not present in the public author repository.

derivation.public_1061: All named loci in the recovered public paralog/sequence-length matrices.
derivation.reproducible_531: Paralog warning class <=10 plus raw sequence occupancy >=0.80; reproducible without manual gene-tree decisions.
derivation.conservative_241: No paralog warning plus raw sequence occupancy >=0.80.
derivation.manual_review_290: 1-10 warning class plus occupancy >=0.80; requires the paper's manual gene-tree review before any promotion.

claim_boundaries: Do not call the 241-locus set the published Moreyra final matrix.
Do not force R1B-0 to reproduce 350 loci.
Do not treat the unresolved 1064-vs-1061 difference as three identified biological loci.
Use conservative_241 as a high-stringency compatibility layer and public_1061 as a broad recovery layer.

r1b0_use.manual_review_layer: not primary unless the manual gene-tree decisions are independently reproduced
